proof_scope: In progress. R1753 proves an exact cleanup inventory and a native eraser for bare nonblank streams. The generator has seven marked words, two lone START markers, four bare streams and 29 blank tapes. Their absolute head positions are now verified: marked words, lone markers and blank tapes have head zero; two streams start at zero and two end at their exact length. Every stream symbol is nonblank. The complete generated page schedule has zero net displacement, so all page heads and the clock head finish at zero. The page tapes and ten radius scratch tapes are already blank. NativeSpanErase physically erases an arbitrary nonblank span, including any START/STOP symbols as ordinary data, in at most 5m+4 steps from its left endpoint or 3m+3 from its right endpoint, restoring the left-end absolute position. Its fixed original-model machine has one tape, five symbols and seven states. Every step is paid; there is no implicit erasure or head reset. These facts prepare a concrete cleanup controller; they do not yet execute the complete cleanup.
